# Encore Performers
## The Place To Dance

> Encore Performers is the premier dance studio in Northern Virginia, located in Chantilly, VA. We offer dance classes for ages 3 through 18 in Jazz, Tap, Hip Hop, Ballet, Pointe, Contemporary, Musical Theatre, and Ballroom.

## About
Encore Performers is a dance studio at 4299 Henninger Ct, Chantilly, VA 20151. Our dancers share a special bond, built on passion, support, and celebration. Whether you are brand new to dance, dancing for fun, or in pursuit of a professional career, we have a program to support your goals.

## Programs
- **Munchkin & Minis** (Ages 3-6): Introductory classes to inspire a lifelong love of dance.
- **Juniors** (Ages 7-11): Build technique, confidence, and friendships across multiple styles.
- **Tweens** (Ages 10-12): Advancing technique and artistic expression.
- **Teens** (Ages 12-18): Advanced training in Jazz, Contemporary, Hip Hop, and more.
- **ITP & ETAP**: Intensive and competitive-level training for dedicated dancers.

## Dance Styles
Jazz, Tap, Hip Hop, Ballet, Pointe, Contemporary, Musical Theatre, Ballroom.

## Summer Programs
Mini Camps (ages 4-6), themed Dance Camps (ages 6-13) including Broadway Intensive, KPOP Hip Hop, Stars On Stage, and Movie Magic. Plus summer intensives and evening classes.

## FAQ
- **What age groups?** Ages 3-18 across Munchkin & Minis, Juniors, Tweens, Teens, ITP, and ETAP.
- **Free trial?** Yes, book at encoreperformers1.dncestudios.com/get-started-new or call 703-222-5511.
- **Experience needed?** Not at all. We welcome beginners.
- **Summer camps?** Yes, multiple themed camps for ages 4-13 plus intensives.
- **Where?** 4299 Henninger Ct, Chantilly, VA 20151.
